title: My certificates
empty: Pass an assessed module to earn a certificate. It appears here straight away, even offline.
heading: Certificate of Safety Training
passed: passed the assessed AR safety training module

note.provisional: Issued on this phone. The training office signs it when the phone next connects to the internet.
note.valid: Signed by the training office. Anyone can check it by scanning the QR code, even offline.
note.expiring: Expires soon. Take the assessment again to renew it.
note.expired: This certificate has expired. Take the assessment again to renew it.
note.revoked: The training office has revoked this certificate.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.intro: Scan the QR code on a worker's certificate, or type its ID.
verify.scanning: Point the camera at the certificate QR code
verify.cameraBlocked: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera for this app, or type the ID.
verify.cameraUnavailable: No camera is available here. Type the certificate ID instead.
verify.notCertificate: This QR code is not an AR Mining Training certificate.
verify.needsOnline: Checking by ID needs the internet. Scanning the QR code works offline.

verdictBody.valid: Genuine: signed by the training office and not expired.
verdictBody.revoked: The training office has revoked this certificate.
verdictBody.provisional: Not signed yet: the worker's phone has not synced. Ask them to connect to the internet.
verdictBody.unknown-key: Signed with a key this phone does not know yet. Connect to the internet once and check again.
verdictBody.invalid: The details do not match the signature. The certificate may have been changed.
verdictBody.not-found: There is no certificate with this ID.

verify.checkedOnline: Confirmed with the training office server
